title: BBA in Management

groups.name: Requirements
groups.source_quote:
ACCT | 2010 | Principles of Accounting I | 3

ECON | Note: ECON 2103 OR ECON 2113 | 3

ECON | Note: ECON 2123 OR ECON 3123 (BSc ECOF students can only use ECON 3123 to fulfill this requirement; while others should take ECON 2123) | 3

FINA | 2303 | Financial Management | 3

ISOM | 2010 | Introduction to Information Systems | 3

ISOM | 2020 | Coding for Business | 1

ISOM | 2500 | Business Statistics | 3

ISOM | 2600 | Introduction to Business Analytics | 1

MGMT | 2010 | Business Ethics and the Individual | 2

MGMT | 2130 | Business Ethics and Social Responsibility | 2

MATH | Note: MATH 1003 OR MATH 1013 OR MATH 1020 OR MATH 1023 | 3-4

SB&M | Note: Courses for BBA majors: ACCT 2200 AND ISOM 2700 AND MARK 2120 AND MGMT 2110 (Students who enroll in the BSc majors of SBM are not required to take these courses for graduation) | 12

groups.name: Required Course(s)
groups.source_quote:
MGMT | Note: MGMT 3110 OR MGMT 3120 (Students in the Human Resources Option must take MGMT 3110 to fulfill this requirement. Students in the Consulting Option must take MGMT 3120 to fulfill this requirement.) | 4

MGMT | Note: MGMT 3130 OR MGMT 3140 (Students in the Consulting Option must take MGMT 3140 to fulfill this requirement.) | 4

MGMT | Note: MGMT 4210 OR MGMT 4220 (Students in the Consulting Option or in the Corporate Social Responsibility and Sustainability Option must take MGMT 4210 to fulfill this requirement.) | 3-4

groups.name: Elective(s)
groups.source_quote:
MGMT | MGMT 3000-level or above Electives (Any 3 courses of the subject and level as specified. Courses taken as Option Required Courses may not be counted towards the elective requirement.) | 9
